# emptyviz

A `ggplot2` theme
([`theme_mt()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/theme_mt.md))
plus a set of composable geoms and plot builders used across the
author’s experimental projects: mean ± 1 SD
violin/half-violin/split-violin geoms for raw observations, and
`ggdist`-based halfeye/ridge/coefficient-grid, location-scale, and log
Bayes Factor forest plot builders for posterior draws from Bayesian
models (typically fit with `brms`).

This package is not intended for general audiences - it’s published so
that the specific analyses that depend on it are reproducible by anyone
who installs the tagged version they were built with.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("mkthalmann/emptyviz")
```

To pin the exact version a given analysis was built with (recommended
for reproducing a specific plot), install a tag or commit instead of the
default branch:

``` r

pak::pak("mkthalmann/emptyviz@v0.1.0")
```

[`theme_mt()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/theme_mt.md)
defaults to the `"Roboto Condensed"` font family, which this package
does not install - it must already be available on the system for text
to render as intended. Most graphics devices fall back to a different
font silently rather than erroring, so a missing font won’t be obvious;
install it, or pass `theme_mt(base_family = "")`/another available
family, if reproducing a plot’s exact appearance matters.

## Usage

``` r

library(emptyviz)
library(ggplot2)

# sets theme_mt() as the active ggplot2 theme
use_theme_mt()
```

``` r

set.seed(42)
demo_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(group = "A", value = rnorm(80, 0, 1)),
  data.frame(group = "B", value = rnorm(80, 1.5, 0.6)),
  data.frame(group = "C", value = rnorm(80, -0.5, 1.8))
)

ggplot(demo_data, aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin_sd() +
  labs(
    title = "geom_violin_sd()",
    subtitle = "aura (full density) + mean &plusmn;1 SD band",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

![](reference/figures/README-violin-example-1.png)

``` r

bf_data <- data.frame(
  contrast = c("A vs. B", "C vs. D", "E vs. F"),
  log_bf = c(8.2, 1.1, -0.4)
)

plot_bf_forest(
  bf_data,
  contrast = contrast,
  log_bf = log_bf,
  direction_labels = c("supports difference", "supports equivalence")
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-bf-example-1.png)

See
[`vignette("geoms-and-theme")`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/articles/geoms-and-theme.md)
for the theme and the three `_sd` violin geoms, and
[`vignette("bayesian-plots")`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/articles/bayesian-plots.md)
for the halfeye/ridge/coefficient-grid, location-scale, and Bayes Factor
forest plot builders.

## Development

``` r

devtools::load_all()
devtools::test()
devtools::check()
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`believe_projection`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/believe_projection.md)
  : Raw judgment data from Thalmann & Matticchio (2024)

- [`believe_projection_bf`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/believe_projection_bf.md)
  : Bayes Factor ROPE contrasts from the believe-projection model

- [`believe_projection_coef_draws`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/believe_projection_coef_draws.md)
  : Posterior fixed-effect coefficient draws from the believe-projection
  model

- [`believe_projection_draws`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/believe_projection_draws.md)
  : Posterior marginal draws from the believe-projection model

- [`geom_half_violin_sd()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/geom_half_violin_sd.md)
  : A half-violin with a mean +/- 1 SD band

- [`geom_split_violin_sd()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/geom_split_violin_sd.md)
  : Two half-violins back to back, split by a two-level column

- [`geom_violin_sd()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/geom_violin_sd.md)
  : A violin with a mean +/- 1 SD band

- [`layer_bf_evidence_scale()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/layer_bf_evidence_scale.md)
  : Weak-evidence region + directional arrows for a log-BF axis

- [`layer_halfeye_hdi()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/layer_halfeye_hdi.md)
  : The recurring halfeye (HDI slab + ETI point-interval) layer bundle

- [`mt_colors`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/mt_colors.md)
  [`mt_colors3`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/mt_colors.md)
  [`mt_colors4`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/mt_colors.md)
  [`mt_colors5`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/mt_colors.md)
  : Base two-color palette

- [`mt_colors_many()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/mt_colors_many.md)
  : Continuous color ramp between the first two base colors

- [`plot_bf_forest()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/plot_bf_forest.md)
  : Log Bayes Factor forest plot

- [`plot_coef_grid_hdi()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/plot_coef_grid_hdi.md)
  : Free-scale grid of posterior coefficients, one panel per category

- [`plot_location_scale()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/plot_location_scale.md)
  : Joint (location, scale) scatter with credible ellipses

- [`plot_ridge_hdi()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/plot_ridge_hdi.md)
  : Ridgeline plot of posterior marginal means/SDs, one row per category

- [`prepare_bf_contrasts()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/prepare_bf_contrasts.md)
  : Split a bayestestR-style contrast string into left/right columns

- [`theme_mt()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/theme_mt.md)
  : A markdown-aware ggplot2 theme

- [`use_theme_mt()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/use_theme_mt.md)
  :

  Activate
  [`theme_mt()`](https://mkthalmann.github.io/emptyviz/reference/theme_mt.md)
  as the session's default theme
